scripts.dev: npm run build:manual && wrangler dev --var DEV_PAGE:1
scripts.chat:on: wrangler d1 execute union-dues-manual-chat --remote --command "INSERT INTO chat_settings (key, value) VALUES ('enabled', '1') ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = '1'"
scripts.chat:off: wrangler d1 execute union-dues-manual-chat --remote --command "INSERT INTO chat_settings (key, value) VALUES ('enabled', '0') ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = '0'"
scripts.chat:status: wrangler d1 execute union-dues-manual-chat --remote --command "SELECT key, value FROM chat_settings ORDER BY key"
